name: Tag Input
hint: Type and press Enter or comma. Backspace twice removes the last tag.
description: Chips input with suggestions, paste-to-split, a max count, and two-step Backspace removal. Adding a tag that already exists nudges the existing chip instead of duplicating it.
usage: Use for free-form lists (skills, topics, recipients, keywords). Pass `value` + `onChange(tags)` if you own the list (or `defaultValue`), `suggestions` for the menu, and `name` to send the tags with a <form> (one hidden input per tag, so FormData.getAll(name) returns them). Set `allowCustom` false to restrict to `suggestions`; check each new tag with `validate(tag, tags)`; show a server error with `error`. `maxTags` 0 means no limit, otherwise the counter shows it. Text left in the box is added on blur; if it is refused, the reason shows and the text stays. Enter on an empty box submits the form. The ref is the text input. In a form with Text Field, Password Field or Textarea, give every field the same `labelPlacement` so the labels read as one design.

keyboard.does: Types into the box and filters the suggestions.
Adds the typed text as a tag, or the suggestion highlighted with the arrows; a tag that already exists is nudged instead of added twice.
keyboard.when: there is text or a highlight

keyboard.does: A comma adds the typed text as a tag, as Enter does.
Moves the highlight through the suggestions; after Escape, ArrowDown opens them again.
Closes the suggestions and keeps focus in the box; a second Escape leaves the box.
Marks the last tag; a second Backspace removes it.
Stops on each tag's remove button, then on the text box.
Removes that tag and puts focus back in the box.

screenReader: The text box is a combobox named by `label`, with aria-expanded and aria-activedescendant for the suggestion listbox (named `messages.suggestions`). A polite live region reads the tag list after every add or remove (`messages.summary`) and says when a typed tag already exists (`messages.exists`); the hint line says when Backspace has marked a tag, and each remove button is named "Remove <tag>" (`messages.remove`). An error is linked with aria-describedby, read assertively and sets aria-invalid.

controls.label: Hint
controls.default: Press Enter or comma to add. Backspace removes.

dataProps.description: "above": a static label over the box (as Password Field and Textarea draw it by default). "float": the label sits inside the box on the first line and floats up on focus or once there is a tag or text, as Text Field draws it by default. Give every field in a form the same value so the labels read as one design.
Controlled tags. Pass with onChange.
Initial tags when uncontrolled. A <form> reset returns to them.
Older name for defaultValue; still works.
(tags: string[]) => void after any add, remove, paste or reset.
(tag: string) => void for each tag added.
(tag: string) => void for each tag removed.
Options for the menu, filtered as you type. Empty by default.

dataProps.type: (tag: string, tags: string[]) => string | null | undefined
dataProps.description: (tag, tags) => string | null. Return a message to refuse the tag (shown as the error, text kept), or null to accept.
An error you already have (for example from the server), shown under the field.

dataProps.type: { max?: (n: number) => string; notInList?: string; armed?: string; remove?: (tag: string) => string; suggestions?: (label: string) => string; summary?: (tags: string[]) => string; exists?: (tag: string) => string }
dataProps.description: Copy, merged over neutral defaults: { max: (n) => `You can add up to ${n}`, notInList: "Pick one from the list", armed: "Press Backspace again to remove", remove: (tag) => `Remove ${tag}`, suggestions: (label) => `${label} suggestions`, summary: (tags) => `${tags.length} tags: …`, exists: (tag) => `${tag} is already added` (read out when a typed tag is already in the list) }.
Forwarded to the text input: focus().
id of the text input. Generated when omitted.
Form field name. Each tag is a hidden input with this name.
autocomplete of the text input.
Focus the text input on mount.
At least one tag: the text input is required (native constraint) while the list is empty, and the label gets *.
Show the tags without remove buttons; nothing can be added.
Sample content for the gallery: tags Motion and Typography, a list of design-skill suggestions. Off by default.
Widest the field grows, in px or a CSS length. 0 removes the cap so it fills its container.

Where the suggestion list renders. true: through a portal into document.body, carrying the theme tokens found at the field, so an ancestor with overflow:hidden, transform or filter can't clip or move it; it keeps the field's width, follows it and flips above it when there is no room below. false: in the field's own DOM (still placed against the viewport). An element or ref: portaled into that element instead.
Any other attribute (name, autoComplete, aria-*, data-*) goes to the text <input>. className and style go to the root <div> and are merged with the component's own.

example:
<form onSubmit={save}>
  <TagInput
    ref={tagsRef}
    label="Topics"
    name="topics"
    placeholder="Add a topic…"
    value={topics}
    onChange={setTopics}
    suggestions={allTopics}
    maxTags={5}
    validate={(t) => (t.length > 24 ? "Keep each topic under 24 characters" : null)}
    error={serverError}
  />
</form>
